info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-List Airline Flights Refunds-v2-spec
info.description: The Airline Flights Refunds API allows developers to retrieve information on eligible refunds for airline flights. This endpoint provides access to a list of flights that qualify for refunds, enabling customers and agents to quickly identify refund options. Typical consumers of this API include customer service representatives and travel agencies who require detailed information to assist travelers. By integrating this API, businesses can enhance their customer service experience by providing timely and accurate refund information.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to access information regarding the refund status of a specific flight. It provides the necessary details that customers need to understand their options for getting a refund.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to initiate a refund for a flight. Ensure that all required fields are included and values are correctly formatted.

202.description: The request has been accepted for processing, and the refund will be processed shortly.
